string.text: The walls have fallen! The defenders fall back into the keep and bar the doors...{newline}Stand to the death!
To the keep! Fall back to the doors!
Too many of your men are still standing: the keep cannot hold that many warriors. You can fall back once {LIMIT} or fewer remain.
Hold the keep! Three waves are coming through the doors.
Wave {WAVE} is breaking through the doors!
The besiegers have lost heart: they lift the siege and march away.
The besiegers send an envoy: their lord wants to talk terms.
The besiegers fall back to their camp to regroup. A new assault is expected in {DAYS} day(s).
You held the keep, I will grant you that. But my army still stands at your gates, and you have a handful of tired men. Let us talk, before more blood is spilled.
Let our realms make peace. I am ready to pay for it.
What would it take for you to let me and my men march out?
There is nothing to talk about. Come and take it, if you can.
As you wish. We will come again, and this time we will not stop at the doors.
So be it. Peace, then. We will be gone by nightfall.
That is not enough. Think again.
Very well. Take your men and go, no one will touch you. The castle is ours.
